name: Grand Sumo tournaments (Nihon Sumo Kyokai)
intro: Professional sumo holds six main tournaments a year, each lasting 15 days, with bouts from morning until the top wrestlers fight in the late afternoon. Every tournament has a fixed ticket sale date, and weekends and the final days sell out fast.

facts.location: Tokyo (January, May, September), Osaka (March), Nagoya (July), Fukuoka (November)
facts.bookAhead: About five weeks: each tournament has its own sale date

statusNote: Sale dates are from the official Japan Sumo Association schedule. The 10:00 start time is from travel sources and an older official ticket page; the current official schedule does not state it.
popularityNote: Not in our keyword data. Estimate: sumo is one of the most requested experiences on travel forums, but tournaments run only six times a year.
difficultyNote: Reasoning from ticket guides: weekend days and the final day of each tournament sell out first; weekday chair seats usually last longer.
bookingSteps: Check the tournament dates and sale dates on the Japan Sumo Association's English site.
Choose a day and a seat type: a box seat on the floor (masu-seki, for up to four people) or a chair seat.
At 10:00 Japan time on the sale day, buy on Ticket Oosumo English, the official ticket site.
Pay by credit card. The English site takes cards only and adds a handling fee per ticket.
Print your tickets at a Seven-Eleven store in Japan, using the details in your confirmation email.
Keep the tickets safe: lost tickets can't be used to enter.
visitorTips: Tickets can't be changed or cancelled for any reason.
Resale or transfer to strangers is prohibited.
Children aged 4 and over need their own ticket.
At the Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, a limited number of same-day tickets are sold at the box office from 8:00.
Ticket Oosumo members can enter a pre-sale lottery before the general sale.

faq.q: When do Grand Sumo tickets go on sale?
faq.a: On a fixed date for each tournament, about five weeks before it starts. Tickets for the January 2027 tournament in Tokyo go on sale on December 5, 2026, reportedly at 10:00 Japan time.

faq.q: Can I buy sumo tickets on the day?
faq.a: In Tokyo, a limited number of same-day general admission tickets are sold at the Kokugikan box office from 8:00. They can run out early on busy days.

sources.quote: Official general sales typically open about one month before each tournament at 10:00 a.m. Japan Standard Time.
Tickets that have been purchased cannot be changed or cancelled for whatever reason.
